title: Replacement of Trestle tower at Agatti Lighthouse in the UT of Lakshadweep - Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized) at Deep Bhavan, Kochi
summary: Two-cover e-tender for fabrication and supply, at Deep Bhavan Kochi, of a 30 m high hot-dip galvanized GI trestle tower to replace the trestle tower at Agatti Lighthouse, Lakshadweep.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Kochi
sites.work: Delivery location for fabricated 30m GI trestle tower

sites.name: Agatti Lighthouse, UT of Lakshadweep
sites.work: Trestle tower to be replaced (tower fabricated and supplied at Kochi)

scope.item: Fabrication & Supply of 30m high GI Trestle tower (Hot dipped Galvanized)

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents by 27.08.2025 15:00. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body
Similar works in last 7 years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost
Similar work: fabrication & hot dip galvanizing and supply of transmission line towers/communication/trestle tower, or structural steel works
PAN and GST registration; CA-certified annual turnover of last three years
Unconditional bid undertaking; not-blacklisted affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper; list of relatives (Gazetted/Accounts officers) in MoPSW/DGLL
EPF/labour registration certificate; tender acceptance letter; bid securing declaration
specs: 30 m high GI trestle tower, hot dipped galvanized
notes: Section I only (pages 2-4), dated 07.08.2025; bilingual header only, body in English. No BOQ/drawings. Bid download/submission 08.08.2025 10:00 to 28.08.2025 15:00; queries by 12.08.2025 15:00; pre-bid 13.08.2025 15:00; technical opening 29.08.2025 15:00. No reference number printed.
